output: Arrr, me hearty! For dinner, how about some hearty stew made with chunks of beef and root vegetables, served with a crusty loaf of bread and a pint of ale to wash it down? But if ye be in the mood for something lighter, perhaps some fresh fish caught just off the coast, with a side of lemon and herbs would do nicely. Whatever ye choose, make sure it's hearty enough to keep ye warm and full through the night!
